claims.text: year_note: "diễn lần đầu 423 TCN; bản còn lại là bản sửa sau đó"

sources.quote: Aristophanes did not stop accusing Socrates in 423 when Clouds placed third
he soon began writing a revision, which he circulated but never produced. Complicating matters, the revision is our only extant version of the play.
